name: Crossroads Shopping Center
summary: Crossroads Shopping Center is a neighborhood retail destination in White Plains, New York, managed by Acadia Realty Trust. Conveniently located on Tarrytown Road, the center serves the local Westchester County community with everyday shopping and services.
demographics: Crossroads Shopping Center serves the affluent White Plains market in Westchester County, attracting middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The primary trade area draws from White Plains and surrounding Westchester communities, with shoppers predominantly aged 30-65 who value convenience and quality. The center appeals to busy professionals and families seeking everyday shopping needs, with a customer base that includes both local residents and office workers from the nearby business district.
description: Crossroads Shopping Center is a well-established neighborhood shopping destination located at 423 Tarrytown Road in White Plains, New York. Managed by Acadia Realty Trust, a prominent real estate investment trust specializing in retail properties, this center serves as a convenient hub for the White Plains community and surrounding Westchester County areas. The shopping center maintains strong community ties and offers a practical mix of retail and service tenants that cater to everyday shopping needs. With its accessible location on Tarrytown Road, Crossroads provides ample parking and easy access for local residents and commuters alike. The center operates daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, ensuring convenient shopping hours for busy families and professionals throughout the week.
